visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a grey t-shirt stands outside Chiayi East Station, gesturing enthusiastically to the camera in a selfie-style shot. The station has a prominent wooden sign and red brick accents. (2) The scene shifts to the man introducing a cafe with a vintage aesthetic; visuals show interior details like old wooden window frames, a William Morris art poster, and minimalist wooden tables. (3) He moves to the exterior of the Chiayi Art Museum, a large historical building with greenish window frames; he mimics taking a photo with his phone and uses a dreamy heart-shaped filter overlay. (4) Transition to the Ximen Innovation Hub, a modern red-brick building with clear signage. The man enters the facility, showcasing a bright, white-walled co-working environment filled with modern IKEA furniture, including desks, task lamps, and indoor plants. (5) He demonstrates specific office features such as height-adjustable desks and a cozy lounge area with leather sofas. (6) In a meeting room, he stands amidst rows of white tables and chairs, spreading his arms to show the scale. (7) Finally, he stands at a whiteboard, writing about IKEA business services and pointing toward the camera for a final sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Geographic Orientation -> Lifestyle Discovery -> Commercial Partnership Integration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the cultural renovation of Chiayi's historic buildings and specifically highlight the IKEA-designed Ximen Innovation Hub co-working space as a destination for digital nomads and local professionals.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of IKEA business services, showcasing of IKEA-labeled office furniture, and a call to action to contact IKEA for space planning.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges local tourism with a commercial interior design service, using a high-energy influencer style to make corporate office solutions feel like a trendy lifestyle choice.
